title: AI Cluster Silent Data Corruption (SDC), Xid/ECC Fault Triage & Sub-60s Warm-Spare Resilient Training Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Reactive Manual Job Restart (No SDC Detection, Poisoned Checkpoints & 38-Min Cold Restart Loop)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Fault every 8.8h + 38m restart + 3 SDC checkpoint poisonings waste 31.6% of cluster ($1.42M/mo)

tiers.name: Tier 2: DCGM + Node Problem Detector (Auto-Cordons Loud Xid 48/74/79/95, Cold Pod Reschedule in 480s)
tiers.verdict: Catches loud Xid/ECC hardware errors, but misses Silent Data Corruption (SDC) and still takes 8m to restart

tiers.name: Tier 3: Warm-Spare Node Swap + Async Checkpoint (Fast 95s Failover, Offline-Only SDC Screening)
tiers.verdict: Fast 95s failover via warm spares, but mid-run thermal SDC can still corrupt 1 checkpoint before offline test

tiers.name: Tier 4: Pre-AllReduce Grad-Norm Gate + Inline Golden-Hash SDC Probe + 42s P2P Memory Checkpoint Failover
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 98.1% Goodput (+29.7 pts), 42s failover, 0 SDC poisonings & -91.9% wasted compute TCO
